# Bench frame recipes (generated)

Generated by `tools/build.sh` + `vapscan_selftest --emit-raw` from the
wifi-vap-scan builders. Do not edit by hand; regenerate with:

    ./tools/build.sh
    /tmp/vapscan_selftest --emit-raw

Every frame starts with the same 12-byte HCC header: group 0, alloc=1,
dst=0, total length, message id, tag 0x5a5a. The SR node the transport
must commit is `word0 = frame devVA`, `word1 = (total<<16)|0x6d2b`
(the word1 value is listed per frame); announce with mailbox id 3.

| frame | total B | SR node word1 | wire validate |
